creator: Julian Osley
alt: Emirates Stadium exterior and supporters in 2010
description: The Emirates Stadium View of one of a series of murals on the exterior of Arsenal Football Club's Emirates Stadium, recalling famous players from its illustrious past. The photograph was taken after a 2-0 win over Sunderland in a Premier League match, 20 February 2010.
caption: Emirates Stadium, Arsenal’s home ground, in 2010. Illustrative club context; the 2026 fixture was played at Newcastle.
